title: Alpha 工廠 API 沒有資料來源：改讀真實的重現 admission 與 queue 紀錄
summary: Replaced dead alpha_factory_cards read-store reader with an authoritative HTTP read from GET /bff/alpha-factory to GET /api/research-orchestrator/alpha-replication/entries joining ReplicationAdmissionStore.list_admissions and AlphaReplicationQueue.list_all on (tenant_id, strategy_spec_id) for the verified caller tenant.

acceptance_criteria_verification.criterion: 1. New owner route GET /api/research-orchestrator/alpha-replication/entries joins ReplicationAdmissionStore.list_admissions with AlphaReplicationQueue.list_all on (tenant_id, strategy_spec_id) and returns every admission of the authenticated tenant.

2. GET /bff/alpha-factory builds its cards from that owner route over HTTP with the verified caller auth and tenant; follows _default_http_get and PANTHEON_RESEARCH_ORCHESTRATOR_API_URL from job_read.py without adding a new client class or reading orchestrator data dir or strategy registry.

3. Each card carries strategy_id, strategy_spec_id, admission status, queue status, attempt_count, experiment_task_id, experiment_run_ids, authority_task_id, last_revalidation_at, approver, and approved_at exactly as recorded by the owner; no metric, Sharpe, or risk value is invented and missing values stay null.

4. Lanes are discovered, scaffolded, and replicated: completed queue entries are replicated; non-completed or unqueued admissions are scaffolded; discovered is empty with reason 'no_candidate_source'.

5. Owner read failure or unconfigured orchestrator URL returns meta.surfaces.alpha_factory with status 'unavailable' and no items; healthy owner with no records returns status 'ok' with empty lanes; separate tests cover both.
6. Caller sees only records of its verified tenant; two-tenant test proves the other tenant is absent from both the owner route and the BFF route.

7. Dead alpha_factory_cards dataset and list_alpha_factory_cards readers removed from WorkflowHookCatalogReaderPort, DomainWorkflowCatalogPort, CompositeOperationsConsultationPort, InMemoryOperationsConsultationPort, and ReadSurfacePorts; tests and inventories updated.
8. BFF route is a sync def so the owner HTTP call cannot block the event loop and test_event_loop_owner_reads_guard.py stays green.

9. Tests use the real hosted admission and queue record shapes including a tw-official strategy_spec_id containing colons in the join key (reg-strategy-spec-tw-official:tw_price_daily:TWSE:2330:e4b598d99f084c19-da7cb8297afb).

test_results.operations_consultation_and_read_surface: 77 passed (1 pre-existing unrelated failure on dev in test_architecture_boundaries.py::test_mutation_route_ownership_mapping_contract from commit a03438afe for POST /bff/personas/{param}/provisioning/paper-capital*)
